name: cover
about: A hostile ranged Troika human whose enemy is in the open takes the tactical cover search (0x102b7110 -> FindHintByClassMask(8, 1, radius)) into SCHED_TROIKA_TAKE_COVER_HINT (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_take_cover_hint.sch: TASK_GET_PATH_TO_HINTNODE, TASK_RUN_PATH, TASK_WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT, TASK_SNAP_TO_HINT, TASK_FACE_ENEMY, TASK_PLAY_COVER_IDLE, TASK_REMEMBER MEMORY:INCOVER, TASK_SET_NPC_FLAG AT_COVER_HINT) with a cover hint claimed (0x102d1350); from cover, SCHED_TROIKA_TAKE_COVER_HINT_ATTACK (sched_troika_take_cover_hint_attack.sch) plays TASK_PLAY_COVER_OUTOF to its end (RunTask 0x102ab834 completes on IsActivityFinished, m_bSequenceFinished raised by StudioFrameAdvance 0x1008f120) and fires TASK_RANGE_ATTACK1. The 2026-09-30 lab run (docs/harness/green-room-arena.md): the gunman on far_ne, the player at the cover seat.
known_red: 1: the body arbiter refuses the kernel's sequence (ElysiumNpcAnim.cpp:402-431)
